specs.name: power
specs.source_sentence: The Alpha and Zeta trims are exclusively powered by the 1.0-litre turbocharged mild hybrid K10C three-cylinder petrol engine producing 100 bhp and 143 Nm of torque while Sigma and Delta trims use the 1.2-litre naturally aspirated  K12N four-cylinder petrol engine producing 90 bhp and 113 Nm of torque.
